holdout_policy: Freeze one finalist before holdout; paired baseline, no tuning on holdout.
plateau: Up to three rounds of structural/weight refinements; stop after two rounds with no selection improvement, or report bounded search and failed control honestly.
selection: Screen top two by goals then mean caps; promote only if selection win count exceeds baseline; unchanged compute policy. Holdout uses exact one-sided paired binomial test on discordant outcomes, no censored games.
